# Learn the Seerah

> Learn the Seerah is a free, browser-based app for learning the life of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, and his Companions: through the Seerah Song by Zain Bikha, a Sahaba timeline with stories of the Companions, an Arabic Seerah poem and Seerah books. Made by Ummah Apps. URL: https://seerah.ummahapps.ai/

## What it does

- The front page has a card for each part of the app: The Seerah Song (with the lines learnt and the streak); an Arabic Seerah poem, Manzumat al-Munirah fi Muhimm 'Ilm as-Sirah (مَنْظُومَةُ الْمُنِيرَةِ فِي مُهِمِّ عِلْمِ السِّيرَةِ), a short poem by Shaykh Dr Salih al-Usaymi, as a YouTube playlist; the Sahaba Timeline; and books to read more: When the Moon Split (the full story of the Seerah) and Shama’il at-Tirmidhi (the Prophet’s character and appearance, peace be upon him), as PDF downloads.
- The Seerah Song page has today’s practice, the choruses to repeat, the 10 sections and the whole song.
- Plays the song line by line, section by section, or as a whole.
- Repeat a line as many times as you like, or slow it down.
- Follow the lyrics and star each line you learn. Stars are saved in the browser on your device.
- Free, with no sign-up.

## Sahaba Timeline

- At https://seerah.ummahapps.ai/sahaba/
- The lives of the Companions of the Prophet, peace be upon him, side by side on one timeline, in the order they became Muslim. A slider moves through time and shows who was alive at each event (the Hijra, Badr, Uhud, the Trench, Hudaybiyyah, the conquest of Makkah, Yarmouk, Qadisiyyah and more) and how old they were.
- Tap a Companion to read their story translated from the book صور من حياة الصحابة (Images from the Lives of the Companions) by Dr Abd al-Rahman Ra'fat al-Basha (الدكتور عبد الرحمن رأفت الباشا), with a "Little ones" version for children and a "Grown-ups" version, a word to learn in each scene, lessons, a short quiz and a put-it-in-order game. Stories so far: Zayd ibn Haritha, Abu Ubayda ibn al-Jarrah, Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf, Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas, Talha ibn Ubaydullah, Abdullah ibn Mas'ud, Sa'id ibn Zayd, Abdullah ibn Jahsh, Ja'far ibn Abi Talib, Asma bint Abi Bakr, Umm Salama, Umm Habiba, Abdullah ibn Abbas, Mu'adh ibn Jabal, Zayd ibn Thabit, Salman al-Farisi, Abu Dharr al-Ghifari, Abdullah ibn Umm Maktum, Hudhayfa ibn al-Yaman, Abu Hurayra, al-Tufayl ibn Amr ad-Dawsi, Thumama ibn Uthal, Abu Ayyub al-Ansari, Ikrima ibn Abi Jahl, Suhayb ar-Rumi, Abu ad-Darda, Usama ibn Zayd, Khabbab ibn al-Aratt, Abdullah ibn Salam and Suraqa ibn Malik.
- Tap the Prophet's line, peace be upon him, for the Seerah told through the Companions: every scene from their stories in which they are with him, in time order, with scenes that follow each other from the same Companion's story on one page, each linking back to that Companion's whole story.
- Dates are approximate.
